title: Executive daily handoff notes
body:
Thu 2026-03-12 - quick handoff / priority log

Top focus (this block):
- Finalize Dedicated capacity announcement talking points for partners call (9:30am PT). Need one simple metric: expected p95 latency improvement vs previous gen = ~18% (confirm with infra).
- Approve rollout plan for autoscaling change (canary then 20% then 100%). Target release window Fri 3/13 02:00-06:00 PT. Confirm SRE on-call and rollback window.
- Follow up with Legal on contract language for private deployments (data residency clause).

Meetings / prep (ordered by time):
- 8:00am PT - Standup with Execs (Samir).
  - Quick ask: 30s update on Dedicated SLA wording + confirm sales comms owner.
- 9:30am PT - Partners call (external) re: Dedicated capacity roadmap.
  - Prep bullets: 3 customer-case examples, timeline (Q2 GA), migration incentives.
  - Leave 5–7 min for Qs re: compliance (Jocelyn to take notes).
- 11:00am PT - Deep dive w/ Serving Runtime (eng) on kernel selection perf regressions.
  - Bring: perf dashboard screenshot, example trace id 0a1b2c3d, target questions for eng: reproducer steps? memory vs compute trade-offs?
- 3:00pm PT - 1:1 with Head of Product (30m).
  - Topics: prioritize per-route observability items vs rollout funding for Optimize feature.

Action / follow-ups (quick bullets, assign & deadline):
- Confirm p95 latency stat with infra (Samir) — due today EOD.
- Legal: get redline for data residency clause (Jocelyn) — needed before Fri launch.
- Draft blog blurb for Dedicated announcement (me) — initial draft by Thu EOD, iterate with comms.
- Raise hotfix PR for batching backoff threshold (eng) — tag eng-plat; link PR after open.
- Check with Ops on capacity buffer for weekend (on-call) — add +10% buffer if no objections by 5pm.

Quick notes to self / brain dump (messy):
- Need a one-liner for sales decks: "Redwood Dedicated: predictable throughput, enterprise-grade controls, deployable in your VPC." Shorten.
- Reminder: surface Optimize quantization recommendation flow in next product review — customers ask for guidance when using smaller GPUs.
- Look into whether we can surface per-customer cache hit rate in Console (metric idea) — useful to show cost savings immediately.
- If we push autoscaling canary, make sure fallback policy maps to older model variant (works across model pinning).

Risks / blockers:
- Kernel perf regression could slip release if not reproducible quickly. Contingency: toggle kernel selection to previous profile and hold release.
- Legal redline delay would block partner commitments for private deployments. Escalate if no response by late afternoon.

Decisions needed (callouts):
- Approve canary -> 20% -> 100% autoscale plan (yes/no) — need SRE ok.
- Finalize customer comms outline for Dedicated (approve draft or ask for edits).

Things to capture during calls (check when done):
- Partners call: specific compliance asks, any migration cost expectations, number of seats expected in pilot.
- Serving Runtime: exact trace ID and perf delta; ask for timeline on fix and rollback plan.

Parking lot / later:
- Revisit pricing tiers for private deployment (per-node + support fee vs flat).
- Brainstorm how to present fallback policy as "resilience SLA" in marketing.
- Follow up with Research on eval harness for quantized models (reproducibility notes).

Personal reminders:
- Block 45m tomorrow morning for writing the Dedicated launch email (no meetings).
- Ping Pay and People Ops re: all-hands catering for Q2 offsite.

Notes to hand off to next shift / colleague:
- If infra confirms latency stat, push draft blog to #comm-drafts and notify Samir.
- If Legal hasn't responded by 4pm, escalate to VP Legal and copy Jocelyn.

Mini log (timestamps I added while working):
- 07:12 - quick look at perf dashboard, flagged trace 0a1b2c3d.
- 07:54 - left msg for Legal re: residency clause.
- 08:05 - synced with Samir; asked to confirm p95 stat today.

End of day check (tick when done):
- [ ] p95 stat confirmed
- [ ] Legal redline received or escalated
- [ ] Draft blog posted to comms channel
- [ ] Autoscale canary sign-off\/rollback plan in place

Random short-hand (so I don't forget):
- PR: platform#842 follow up (perf backoff)
- Jira: RI-2891 (autoscale), RI-2910 (private-deploy contracts)
- Slack threads: #partners-prod, #serving-runtime

— Maya
